newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ESS rating, forecast cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ESS rating, forecast cut.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist analyst Rob Chaplinsky said he cut his rating on ESS Technology Inc to buy from strong buy following the company's report of weaker-than-expected second quarter earnings.
-- said he cut his second quarter earnings estimate to $0.17 a share, before charges, from $0.26, cut his full-year 1997 estimate to $1.24 from $1.60, and cut his 1998 estimate to $1.76 from $2.10.
-- based cuts on lower PC audio chip and Video CD chip sales.
-- said earnings will bottom out in the second quarter.
